result.summary: The page is mostly intact. One clear visual defect: the hero image for the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' did not load and shows a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon. The clipped carousel item at the right edge and the cut-off pizza card at the bottom are normal scroll behaviour and are not reported.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in the 'Popular right now' section has no cover photo. It shows a flat grey box with a broken-image icon, while the other restaurant cards display food imagery.
issues.suggestion: Check that the image URL or asset for this restaurant is valid and loads. Add a branded fallback (e.g. a cuisine illustration or restaurant logo) so a failed load never shows a raw broken-image icon.
